errors.0: No connection to the server. Check the network, then try again.
errors.401: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.403: You are not allowed to do this at this branch.
errors.404: Not found. It may have been removed, or you cannot see it.

fleetSetup.title: Fleet Setup
fleetSetup.subtitle: Number series, settings, approvals and labour cost rates for your company and branches
fleetSetup.subtitleReadOnly: Fleet settings as they apply to your company and branches (read-only)
fleetSetup.countPerBranchHint: Each branch counts on its own and its code is printed in the number.
fleetSetup.issuedLock: Numbers were issued; changing this would repeat numbers
fleetSetup.emptySeriesBody: Set up the default number series for work orders, purchase orders and the other fleet documents, and the default settings.
fleetSetup.emptySettingsBody: Fleet uses the built-in defaults until your company changes a setting.
fleetSetup.initHint: Adds the default series and settings your company does not have yet. Existing rows are never changed.
fleetSetup.initFailed: Could not set up the defaults
fleetSetup.removeOverrideBody: Remove the {code} override at {scope}? The branch will use the tenant-wide series again.
fleetSetup.exampleBranchHint: BR01 stands for the branch code printed at each branch.
fleetSetup.readOnlyHint: You can view the settings. Changing them needs the Fleet setup permission for the whole company.
fleetSetup.resetToTenantBody: Remove the override at {scope}? The branch will use the tenant-wide value again.
fleetSetup.approvalsHint: Each document type can need several approval levels. A branch with its own levels uses those instead of the tenant-wide ones.
fleetSetup.scopeFixed: The scope cannot change: delete and add instead.
fleetSetup.branchRulesReplace: Branch levels replace the tenant-wide ones for this document type.
fleetSetup.amountHint: Empty = always applies (leave the currency empty too).
fleetSetup.laborHint: Internal cost of one workshop hour per trade, dated. A new rate ends the rate in force the day before. The price charged to customers is the repair tariff, not this.
fleetSetup.tradesFailed: Could not load the trade list (FLEET_TRADE).
fleetSetup.deleteRateBody: Delete the {trade} rate from {from}? The rate before it applies again.
fleetSetup.endsPrevious: The current rate ends the day before.

rule.prefix: Letters and digits only, e.g. WO.
rule.yearly: A yearly reset must print the year, or two years would share numbers.
rule.monthly: A monthly reset must print the month (YYYYMM or YYMM), or two months would share numbers.
rule.startFits: The start number does not fit in the digits.
rule.locked: Numbers were issued; changing this would repeat numbers
rule.duplicate: This series already exists in this scope. Edit that one instead.
rule.amountCurrency: Give a currency with a minimum amount, and neither for a level that always applies.
rule.duplicateLevel: This level already exists in this scope.
rule.otBelow: Overtime cannot cost less than a normal hour.
rule.afterLatest: Start after the latest rate; earlier rates are history.
rule.endBeforeStart: The end date is before the start date.
rule.endBeforeNext: The next rate starts then: this one must end before it.

settingDesc.COSTING_METHOD: How stock issues are valued. WMA = weighted moving average (the only method for now).
settingDesc.NEGATIVE_STOCK_ALLOWED: Yes = an issue may take stock below zero.
settingDesc.BASE_CURRENCY: Currency of stock values and the stock ledger. Set it before the first receipt; never change it afterwards.
settingDesc.LABOUR_ROUNDING_MINUTES: Labour time on a work order is rounded up to this many minutes.
settingDesc.OVER_RECEIPT_TOLERANCE_PCT: How far (in %) a goods receipt may exceed the ordered quantity.
settingDesc.INVOICE_MATCH_TOLERANCE_PCT: Three-way match tolerance in %: a vendor invoice inside it needs no approval.
settingDesc.INVOICE_MATCH_TOLERANCE_AMOUNT: Three-way match tolerance in base currency.
settingDesc.METER_MAX_KM_PER_DAY: A meter reading implying more km per day than this is held as SUSPECT.
settingDesc.TYRE_MIN_TREAD_MM: Tread depth (mm) at which a tyre must be pulled.
settingDesc.TYRE_TREAD_WARNING_MM: Axle map: tread (mm) below which a tyre shows amber.
settingDesc.TYRE_TREAD_CRITICAL_MM: Axle map: tread (mm) below which a tyre shows red (plan the change).
settingDesc.TYRE_PRESSURE_TOLERANCE_PCT: Axle map: pressure further than this % from the target is flagged.
settingDesc.BLOCK_DISPATCH_ON_OOS_DEFECT: Yes = an out-of-service defect tells Trucking to take the asset out of dispatch.

docType.VENDOR_INVOICE: Vendor invoice outside the match tolerance
